test.text: Navigate to the image; a screen reader should announce it as ignored (no description).
Tab to the image; focus should not stop on a decorative image.

steps: Determine if the image conveys meaning.
If decorative, add alt="" and role="presentation".
If meaningful, replace alt="" with a concise description.
Save the file and validate the HTML.
content.explanation: The lacks alternative text, so screen‑reader users hear nothing about the image. If it’s decorative, it must be marked as such; otherwise provide a descriptive alt. This affects users relying on assistive tech.

verification.note: axe-core fails the original snippet and passes the fixed one.
